queries.sql: SELECT a.audit_log_personne_id AS id, a.personne_id, a.action, a.table_cible, a.enregistrement_id, a.adresse_ip::text AS adresse_ip, a.user_agent, a.created_at, TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(p.prenom_personne, ''), ' ', COALESCE(p.nom_personne, ''))) AS complainant_name, p.email AS complainant_email, p.telephone AS complainant_phone, p.numero_cni AS complainant_cni FROM "audit_log"."audit_log_personne" "a" LEFT JOIN "plaignant"."personne" "p" ON "p"."personne_id" = "a"."personne_id" ORDER BY "a"."created_at" DESC

SELECT DISTINCT p.personne_id AS id, TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(p.prenom_personne, ''), ' ', COALESCE(p.nom_personne, ''))) AS label FROM audit_log.audit_log_personne a JOIN plaignant.personne p ON p.personne_id = a.personne_id ORDER BY label
